name: GOOSE supervision timeout interface
summary: Reports that the expected event-message supervision interval has expired.
description: Reports that the expected event-message supervision interval has expired. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Publisher supervision state” at the input and “Message timeout alarm” at the output. Timeout settings affect interpretation.
